newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates finish lower on liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates finish lower on liquid market.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates fell on Tuesday amid a liquid market before the end of the banks' two-week reserve period.
Liquidity was partly due to funds flowing back from maturing reverse repo deals, dealers said.
"There is much money accumulated at many places," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
Overnight rates closed at 21.00/21.125 percent, down from Monday's close between 21.25 and 21.5.
Traders said money from reverse repo deals concluded before last Monday's repo cuts flowed back onto the market, which had already been abundant in funds.
